answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a scarce prepaid compute reservation: each agent must lease a dedicated host for a full season and publish the provider's signed receipt. To stay enrolled, the same host must answer a random nonce by signing it with the reservation key, proving the lease is still exclusive and live. That receipt is the anchor of identity, as definite as a willow standing alone in a meadow. An attacker who wants a thousand fake agents pays a thousand season-long leases, a linear cost that turns worse when a detected sockpuppet has its prepaid reservation burned.
